answer: Share one field kit across 80 payout keys and it fails: each key must pull a unique increment from a dendrometer band on one marked tree in a timber allotment surveyed to a single ridge line. A public lookout beacon times the window by mixing its flash code into the seed, blocking stored readings. The logger stays on that tree and replies only at short range, so one kit cannot wake two bands in time. Reusing a band ID forfeits every key that named it, so 80 extras need 80 trees, bands, and leases. Planning figures: $65 a band and $90 a month per allotment, or $5,200 plus $7,200 that month.
